veranderings.rede: The paragraph speaks of 'die nuwe seun'; 'die kind' briefly reads as a different child, so 'die seun' makes the reference clear.
A comma closes the dat-clause before the second instruction starts, so the two commands do not run together; the protected 'bly naby ander kinders' is untouched.
The rest of the block says 'grootmens' (including 'n ander grootmens' in the next sentence), which is also the more natural Grade 5 word; one word for one person keeps the reference clear.

veranderings.blok: Wie wat doen in die plan
veranderings.voor: uit die lys van waar hulp is
veranderings.rede: 'die lys van waar hulp is' is wooden and 'van waar' can read as 'vanwaar'; naming the list by its heading is clearer without changing the meaning.
